name: Bram
description: Bram stands behind the bar, broad-shouldered and stone-faced, polishing the same mug like it personally offended him.
dialogue: Bram sizes you up. "If you want a [drink], speak up. If you want [food], pay first. If you want [work], the board's west."
"New face." Bram wipes the counter. "You need [room], [drink], or [work]. If you're here for [rumors], buy something."
